name: One game, and what it says about itself
description: Everything a page needs about one game that is not a standing. `about`, `presets` and `limits` are the CARTRIDGE'S OWN COPY out of its manifest, so a second game is a registration and not a web deploy; a cartridge that ships no `about` gets null and the page drops the section. `weight_classes` is the season's size caps, ordered by cap -- the order admission classifies in. There is no compute cap to join to (decision 46).

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'id', g.slug, 'name', g.name, 'about', g.manifest -> 'about', 'presets', g.manifest -> 'presets', 'limits', g.manifest -> 'limits', 'strike_limit', ($2)::int, 'weight_classes', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('class', e ->> 'class', 'max_bytes', (e ->> 'max_bytes')::bigint) ORDER BY (e ->> 'max_bytes')::bigint) FROM current_season(g.id) cs, jsonb_array_elements(cs.weight_classes) AS e), 'season', (SELECT season_json(s) FROM current_season(g.id) s)) AS body FROM games g WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
